children: Lear approved a $1.5 billion share repurchase authorization and extended the program through December 31, 2029.
Board increased share repurchase authorization to $1.5 billion and extended the authorization period to Dec. 31, 2029.
Approximately $600 million remained on prior authorization at Q2 2026; new total equals ~26% of market cap at current prices.
Since 2011 Lear repurchased 63.6M shares for $6.1 billion, reducing shares outstanding by ~60% since program start.
Repurchases may be executed via open-market, accelerated, private or structured transactions at the Company's discretion.
